title: SEBI Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) — Exit Flexibility & ISIN-Level NAV
summary: SEBI proposed allowing AIFs to retain funds beyond permissible fund life for ongoing tax/litigation demands with 75% investor consent by value, capped at 3 years.

blocks.content: **Overview**: SEBI proposed allowing AIFs to retain funds beyond permissible fund life for ongoing tax/litigation demands with 75% investor consent by value, capped at 3 years.

items: **SEBI proposes exit flexibility for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs)** (Page 8): SEBI proposed allowing AIFs to retain funds beyond permissible fund life for ongoing tax/litigation demands with 75% investor consent by value, capped at 3 years.
**SEBI Tightens AIF Disclosure Norms; Mandates ISIN-Level NAV Reporting** (Page 16): SEBI mandated AIFs to upload scheme-wise NAV data at ISIN level directly to depositories within 30 days.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Alternative Investment Fund Regulation. 75% investor consent for fund extension and ISIN depository uploads.
